name: Freeports, safe deposit boxes and bearer instruments
description: Value is parked and moved in forms that hide ownership and leave thin transaction trails: high-value goods in free ports or bonded storage, contents of safe deposit boxes, and bearer shares or other bearer instruments. Title can change hands without goods moving or any bank payment, so owners are obscured and value can be transferred or revalued on paper. Cash used to buy bearer instruments or fill boxes breaks the link to the original source.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing in the Art and Antiquities Market, 2023
FATF, Money Laundering Vulnerabilities of Free Trade Zones, 2010
OECD, Trade-based money laundering: free trade zones and illicit trade, 2018

indicators.name: Art or collectibles held in free ports without display or trade
indicators.canon: Art or collectibles held in free ports without display or trade
indicators.desc: Artworks are acquired and stored long term in free ports with no movement, display or documented purpose.
indicators.ctx: Art, wine, precious metals or collectibles remain in a free-port or bonded warehouse for long periods with no display, sale or loan.

indicators.name: Safe deposit boxes
indicators.desc: Physical storage of unknown assets with limited visibility.
indicators.ctx: Customer rents a large or multiple safe deposit boxes with no clear need, or in a branch far from home or work.

indicators.name: Bearer shares or bearer instruments
indicators.desc: Entity has issued, or may issue, bearer shares or warrants transferable without registration.
indicators.ctx: Bearer shares or bearer negotiable instruments hold the stored goods, or transfer in place of registered title.
indicators.fp: Legacy bearer shares may be immobilised or custodied under regulation.

indicators.name: High-value asset held through opaque vehicle
indicators.canon: High-value asset held through opaque vehicle
indicators.desc: Property, art, vessels or other valuables are acquired or held via a company, trust or storage arrangement with concealed beneficial owners.
indicators.ctx: Stored high-value goods are owned by a company, trust or foundation whose controller is not apparent to the storage operator or bank.
indicators.fp: Privacy-motivated and estate-planning holdings can be lawful; verify beneficial ownership.

indicators.name: Payments to or from free-trade zones and tax-free ports
indicators.canon: Payments to or from free-trade zones and tax-free ports
indicators.desc: Transfers linked to zones known for tobacco diversion.
indicators.ctx: Payments for goods or storage involve free-trade zones or tax-free ports with no link to the buyer, seller or goods origin.

indicators.name: Provenance gaps or documents inconsistent with object history
indicators.canon: Provenance gaps or documents inconsistent with object history
indicators.desc: Missing ownership chain, 1970-era gap or fake certificates.
indicators.ctx: Provenance papers for stored objects have gaps, conflict with each other or with the object's recorded history.

indicators.name: High-value purchases paid in cash, crypto or non-standard funds
indicators.canon: High-value purchases paid in cash, crypto or non-standard funds
indicators.desc: High-value assets are bought with cash, crypto, third-party or otherwise non-standard funding.
indicators.ctx: Goods placed in storage were bought with cash, virtual assets or funds from an unrelated third party.
indicators.fp: Some buyers legitimately pay with cash or crypto; verify source of funds.

indicators.name: Frequent purchase of monetary instruments in small amounts
indicators.canon: Frequent purchase of monetary instruments in small amounts
indicators.desc: Multiple money orders, drafts, prepaid cards or cheques purchased with cash in sub-threshold amounts.
indicators.ctx: Many small purchases of money orders, bearer bonds or similar instruments, often with cash, to stay under identification limits.
indicators.fp: Some customers lack bank accounts and use instruments for rent or bills.

indicators.name: Stored goods change title or are revalued repeatedly with no physical movement
indicators.canon: Stored goods change title or are revalued repeatedly with no physical movement
indicators.desc: Ownership of goods held in secure storage passes between parties, or declared value changes sharply on entry, exit or transfer, while the items stay in place.
indicators.ctx: A chain of related-party sales of a painting or bullion in a free port that drives up recorded value without cash movement.
indicators.fp: Dealers, collectors and investment funds legitimately trade stored stock without moving it. Concern is a chain of related-party sales or valuations that diverge from the market.

indicators.name: Safe deposit box access clustered around cash deposits or withdrawals
indicators.canon: Safe deposit box access clustered around cash deposits or withdrawals
indicators.desc: Box visits coincide in time with large cash deposits, cash withdrawals, or purchases of cash-like instruments at the same institution.
indicators.ctx: Repeated box access shortly before or after large cash transactions or foreign currency exchange.
indicators.fp: Customers sometimes keep cash savings or valuables in boxes for ordinary reasons, and visits may coincide with legitimate banking.
